description: Shows time series charts from other plugins in a panel.

descriptionFull.title: Shows a chart for each time series another plugin provides, such as Fetch Timeseries. List those plugins under Source plugins.

name: SeriesChart

components.name: Source plugins
components.description: Plugins whose time series this panel charts, separated by commas. Leave empty for fetch-timeseries.

components.name: Variable picker
components.description: How a chart with several variables lets the viewer pick one. dropdown: a select above the chart, for a side panel. list: a row of buttons above the chart, for a wide bottom panel. One variable shows at a time either way.
